_note: The ONE place to retime the film. All values are seconds. Scene 'start' values are film times; everything inside a scene is an offset from that scene's start. 'end' is informational (a scene ends where the next starts). v04 is timed to voice-over take 1 (audio/tbc-restaurants-company_job-advert_voiceover-take1_ar_v02.mp3), which is placed at audio_offset in the film; 'vo_at' is the measured film time of each phrase (silencedetect at -35 dB, plus the offset). Word offsets inside the headline phrase are estimated from the phrase length, not measured per word.
